extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: VAP-Data is the largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation, containing over 100K curated paired video samples across 100 semantic conditions. The dataset covers four primary categories: concept (entity transformation and interaction), style, motion (human and non-human), and camera movement. Each sample consists of paired reference and target videos sharing the same non-pixel-aligned semantic controls. The dataset was constructed by collecting 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, then using Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu (Intelligent Creation Lab, ByteDance; The Chinese University of Hong Kong)
extraction.publisher: ByteDance; The Chinese University of Hong Kong
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The authors collected 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. They then used Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates (some restrict subject categories). This resulted in over 100K samples across 100 semantic conditions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Software Collection, Others (synthetic generation using commercial models and community LoRAs)
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images collected from the Internet, covering men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. Paired videos were generated using Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs (Civitai).
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Reference images were matched to all compatible Image-to-Video visual-effects templates (with some restrictions based on subject category) to generate paired videos with shared semantic controls. Videos were resized to 480×720(832) with 49 frames sampled at 16fps.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos are encoded into latents using a VAE encoder. Videos were resized to 480×720(832) and 49 frames were sampled at 16fps following pre-trained DiT requirements.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Captions for reference and target videos are used to aid in finding and transferring the shared semantic control signals. The authors employ standard video descriptions as captions to stay close to the original DiT distribution.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Commercial Image-to-Video models (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs (Civitai) were used to generate paired video data. Gemini-2.5-pro and GPT-5 were used as automatic scorers for the semantic alignment metric during evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors state they will accompany any artifact release with a research-only license and an acceptable-use policy (AUP) that explicitly prohibits abusive or unlawful scenarios.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset includes reference images spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. Human subjects with various demographics (gender, age) are represented in the reference images and videos.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The authors discuss potential misuses including identity impersonation, 'deepfake' content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media. Mitigations include a research-only release and default content filters blocking harmful categories (e.g., sexual content, explicit violence, hate symbols). The dataset is not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, so VAP may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., if the source models are poor at generating hands, VAP will likely not learn to generate hands well from this data).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models, which may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates. Building a large, real-world, semantic-controlled video dataset would help address this issue but is left for future work. Additionally, inaccurate semantics descriptions or large subject mismatch between reference and target can degrade generation quality.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for training, testing, and validation of semantic-controlled video generation models. It targets research, education, and creative prototyping, where a reference video and an optional caption steer concept/style/motion/camera. For evaluation, 24 semantic conditions were evenly sampled from the 4 categories with 2 samples each, totaling 48 test samples. It is not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments.
